subject.title: Named profiles migrate approval state from the default profile

question: Should ClawSweeper repair this by making legacy approval migrations skip default-profile approval files whenever `OPENCLAW_PROFILE` is a non-default named profile?
rationale: The likely code change is narrow, but it touches approval policy and profile-isolation semantics, so maintainer intent should confirm the migration boundary before automation edits security-sensitive startup behavior.

options.title: Guard named profiles
options.body: Preserve the shipped bare-state-dir migration while preventing non-default named profiles from importing or archiving default-profile approval files.

options.title: Design broader migration policy
options.body: Pause automation and define a wider state-migration contract for all profile-derived state roots before changing this approval path.

options.title: Keep current migration
options.body: Accept that named profiles may consume default legacy approval files as part of the existing custom-state-dir compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Guard named profiles
recommendation.body: Preserve the shipped bare-state-dir migration while preventing non-default named profiles from importing or archiving default-profile approval files.

likelyOwner.reason: The implicated migration and profile-env code currently blames to `obviyus`, making them the best code-history owner for confirming the boundary.
